title: The Survivor Returns
description: Kelsier arrives at Lord Tresting's plantation where the nobleman entertains an obligator sent by Lord Venture, hoping to gain Venture's business partnership. That evening, when a skaa girl is about to be taken to Tresting, Kelsier intervenes—killing Tresting and all his obligators, taskmasters, and soldiers, finally burning the manor to the ground.

title: Hidden Observer
description: Kelsier watches Camon's crew operate from the shadows, noting Vin's unconscious use of Allomancy—a street urchin with Mistborn powers.

title: Recruiting Vin
description: Vin tries to flee Camon's lair but Ulef betrays her. Kelsier intervenes, saving Vin from Camon's beating. He promotes Milev to crewleader, takes the three thousand boxings as payment for dealing with the obligator and Inquisitor, and rents the den for his evening meeting. He then tests Vin and confirms she is a Mistborn.

title: The Atium Heist
description: Kelsier, Dockson, and Vin head to the rooftop. Kelsier gears up and heads off into the mists to break into Keep Venture and steal atium. He gets the safe, but has to fight hazekillers on his way out. He escapes with the atium, funding the rebellion.

title: The Crew Assembles
description: At Clubs' carpentry shop, Kelsier and the crew plot the destruction of the Final Empire. Marsh eventually arrives, and everyone leaves so the two brothers can talk alone. Vin returns to eavesdrop outside the door.

title: Teaching the Apprentice
description: Kelsier takes Vin out for her first night of training, giving her a Mistcloak. He teaches her about the eight basic metals at the Luthadel city walls near Steel Gate.

title: The Renoux Cover
description: Kelsier takes Vin over the Luthadel walls into the night wilderness, where they encounter a mistwraith. On the main road, Sazed waits with a carriage and takes them to Fellise. On the way, Kelsier offers Vin the three thousand boxings and the chance to leave the crew if she doesn't trust him. At Lord Renoux's estate, he establishes her cover identity as Lady Valette.

title: Planning the Revolution
description: Back in Luthadel, Kelsier holds a progress meeting at Clubs' shop. Before the meeting, he asks Sazed about a religion with power—Sazed tells him about Jaism—and whether any religion includes the slaughter of noblemen as a holy duty. The meeting ends when one of Hammond's soldiers reports the Ministry has found Camon's old lair.

title: The Warehouse Rally
description: Kelsier preaches revolution to gathered skaa workers at a secret rally in the warehouse district. Breeze and his Soothers and Rioters manipulate the crowd to be more receptive to the speech, using his legend as the Survivor of Hathsin to inspire the rebellion.

title: Camon's Lair Massacre
description: Kelsier and the crew investigate the destroyed lair. After leaving, Kelsier tries to find Camon among the beggars. He finds Camon's corpse hung from a hook rammed through his mouth—wrists and ankles tied, body tortured. This method of execution is reserved for those who abuse Allomancy. Vin had successfully tailed Kelsier, and they speak briefly after the discovery.

title: Planning at Fellise
description: Kelsier meets with Vin and Sazed at Lord Renoux's estate in Fellise, reviewing the intelligence from Vin's first ball. He learns that Vin's father was at the ball, then heads out into the mists to return to Luthadel.

title: Palace Reconnaissance
description: Kelsier leads Vin into Kredik Shaw to scout the building the Lord Ruler visits every three days. They fight their way in, but three Steel Inquisitors converge on them. Kelsier is separated from Vin during the chaos. Vin escapes gravely wounded, clutching a mysterious leather-bound book.

title: Aftermath of Kredik Shaw
description: The crew argues about Kelsier's decision to take Vin to Kredik Shaw. Before they can go out to search, Sazed arrives carrying her. Dockson is furious about the risk. Kelsier and Dockson notice the leather-bound book Vin brought back—Sazed identifies it as written in Khlenni, the language of the Lord Ruler's pre-Ascension homeland, and thinks he may be able to translate it.

title: Watching Over Vin
description: Kelsier stays at Clubs' shop watching over Vin as she recovers from her injuries sustained at Kredik Shaw, present when she finally wakes up.

title: Meeting at Renoux Estate
description: Kelsier travels to Fellise with Breeze, Yeden, and Dockson to meet with Lord Renoux at his estate, discussing the next phase of the rebellion.

title: Stoking the House War
description: Kelsier sows chaos to build the House War by leaving the obviously-murdered body of Lord Charrs Entrone in the garden of Keep Tekiel, then heads to the Sootwarrens to meet up with Hoid—an informant masquerading as a street contact—to find out what rumors exist regarding House Renoux. From Hoid, he also learns that Lady Shan Elariel is a Soother.

title: Meeting Lord Straff
description: Kelsier goes to Ahlstrom Square, pretending to be a sickly, lame skaa beggar and street informant to meet Lord Straff Venture, leader of House Venture. He learns that rumors about the Survivor of Hathsin are spreading, and that there is talk of an Eleventh Metal.

title: Return to Renoux
description: Kelsier returns to Mansion Renoux using the Spikeway, trading intelligence with Vin, Sazed, and Renoux. He lectures Vin about noblemen, insisting they don't care about the skaa and that she should keep away from Elend.

title: Overseeing Supplies
description: Kelsier is at the Renoux estate in Fellise, overseeing the weapons and supplies being loaded onto carts to be shipped out for the rebellion.

title: The Rebel Army
description: Kelsier reads a translation of the Lord Ruler's logbook as he travels by canal boat to the north. The caravan stops at a lock, and Kelsier, the recruits, and the supplies leave to head to the caves where the rebel army trains. Overcoming memories of the Pits of Hathsin, he enters the Arguois cave complex and inspects the army Ham has been forming. During a dinner, Kelsier Riots Bilg's emotions, intending to use him as an example. Bilg and Demoux duel, with Kelsier using Allomancy to help Demoux—the smaller of the two—win. After the duel, the army's confidence soars as Yeden believes Kelsier can grant his powers to others. Kelsier wants Ham to return to Luthadel with him, handing the army over to Yeden.

title: Shadowing Vin
description: Kelsier appears outside the tower window where Vin is eavesdropping on Elend's group at Keep Hasting. He dismisses their idealistic talk about changing the world as typical young nobleman behavior that never leads to real change. They both leave and go their separate ways.

title: Crew Status Meeting
description: Kelsier arrives at Clubs' shop where many of the crew are gathered. He discusses the status of the mission and shares a late-night drink with Spook, Ham, and Clubs. He asks Ham to go to the Garrison for intelligence.

title: Desperate Decision
description: At Clubs' shop, Kelsier learns that the skaa rebellion has attacked the Holstep Garrison and the Luthadel Garrison is moving north. He decides to try to warn the rebel army and makes Vin swallow five pewter beads for a long pewter drag northward.

title: Disaster at Holstep
description: Kelsier and Vin run for sixteen hours, burning pewter continuously. They encounter the remains of the rebel army, surrounded and slaughtered by the Valtroux Garrison. Kelsier wants to join the fight and save who he can, but Vin convinces him they are not invincible. They continue on to the Arguois Caverns, where 2,000 soldiers survived thanks to Mennis keeping them prepared. Mennis tells Kelsier not to be too upset—this was one of the biggest victories the skaa have had against the Lord Ruler in centuries.

title: Picking Up the Pieces
description: Back at Clubs' shop after two weeks returning from the caverns, the crew talks about the future of the job—it appears to be a total failure. Breeze blames Kelsier for chasing fame and glory. Kelsier admits it's been a setback but refuses to abandon the revolution.

title: The Executions
description: Spook announces executions at Fountain Square. The crew head to the square, bribing someone at a building for rooftop access. They watch many skaa murdered, their blood emptied into the fountain. Kelsier convinces the crew to continue the job, pointing at the atrocity: 'This is our enemy. There is no quarter here, no walking away.'

title: New Strategy
description: The crew returns to Clubs' shop to plan their next moves—starting a house war between the nobility. Sazed delivers a message from Marsh, telling Kelsier where the two can meet in the Twists.

title: The Gold Metal
description: Kelsier and Vin head out to an abandoned building in the Twists hours before the meeting with Marsh. While waiting, Kelsier talks about gold—the ninth Allomantic metal that lets a user see an alternative past version of themselves. He also explains Feruchemy and gives Vin some gold to burn for her first experience with it. When Marsh arrives, bearing the tattoos of a low-ranked obligator from the Canton of Inquisition, he describes the Soothing stations in Luthadel and reveals that Inquisitors can die of old age.

title: War Council at Renoux
description: Kelsier joins the majority of the crew at Renoux's estate in Fellise, going over a very detailed map of Luthadel's defenses provided by Marsh. While studying the map, they discover that Theron's crew was recently hit by the Ministry. Later at night, unable to sleep, Kelsier has Sazed tell him about some of the religions he knows.

title: Scolding the Apprentice
description: Kelsier and Vin return to Clubs' shop after Vin killed Lady Shan Elariel—a fully-fledged Mistborn—at Keep Venture. Kelsier scolds Vin for the reckless fight, but she screams back that noblemen and skaa are not so different, and that Elend Venture is a good man worth protecting.

title: Finding Marsh
description: Kelsier and Vin find Marsh's body—drained of all blood, a lifeless shell. Back at Clubs' shop, they discover a letter from Marsh explaining that the Inquisitors would probably find him.

title: Destroying the Pits
description: Kelsier returns to the Pits of Hathsin—the site of his greatest suffering. He kills all the guards and offers a hand to a skaa named Wallin coming out of the cavern. Then he destroys every atium crystal, cutting off the Lord Ruler's most valuable resource in a single night.

title: The Backup Lair
description: Kelsier returns to a dank backup cellar safehouse near Clubs' shop—just three rooms. He announces he destroyed all the atium at the Pits of Hathsin.

title: The Inquisitor Fight
description: Everyone follows Kelsier to Fountain Square. They spot Spook and Lord Renoux in one of the execution carts. Kelsier fights an Inquisitor in the square—a trap, as he almost certainly knew it would be.

title: The Survivor's Last Stand
description: Kelsier fights the Inquisitor in an all-out battle at Fountain Square, both burning atium. He is a master of Push and Pull, moving metal through the air like an expert. He kills the Inquisitor and the skaa begin chanting 'The Survivor of Hathsin.' The Lord Ruler arrives in a black carriage. One of Ham's thugs rams a spear through him—he continues walking. Two spears—still walking. The Lord Ruler slaps Kelsier, pulls a spear from his own body, and rams it through Kelsier. He dies with a smile, becoming a martyr whose death ignites the revolution. Kelsier represents Hope.

title: Beyond Death
description: At the backup safehouse near Clubs' shop, the crew sees the kandra, earlier Lord Renoux, wearing Kelsier's body and bones - the final plan. Kelsier had left letters to each crew member with instructions for taking the city. His death was the spark that set the revolution ablaze across Luthadel.

title: Cognitive Shadow
description: Kelsier awakens as a Cognitive Shadow in the Well of Ascension after his death, trapped between realms. Hoid arrives through the perpendicularity, chiding Kelsier for destroying the Pits of Hathsin before transitioning to the Physical Realm and stealing a bead of lerasium. Leras (Preservation) appears and lectures Kelsier on the three Realms: Physical, Cognitive, and Spiritual.

title: Watching the World
description: Kelsier rides Ruin's pulses to observe the world beyond his prison. He notices Ruin paying special attention to Vin—a certain Mistborn. He watches her patrol Luthadel's walls, train with her new wolfhound kandra, and begin to sense the mist spirit that is Preservation trying to guide her.

title: Ruin's Schemes
description: Kelsier discovers that Ruin is altering the Terris religion from the Conventical of Seran. Meanwhile, Marsh—now fully under Ruin's control—abandons Sazed at the Conventical and vanishes. Kelsier watches helplessly as Sazed discovers Kwaan's inscription and begins his crisis of faith.

title: Observing the Siege
description: Kelsier watches Vin demonstrate terrifying power at Straff's parley, then sees Elend deposed by the Assembly. Ruin orchestrates the koloss army's approach while manipulating Zane to isolate Vin. Kelsier is infuriated to see Elend ruling Luthadel but grows to respect his efforts. He notices Ruin deliberately letting Vin see him attack Elend.

title: The Well Chamber
description: Vin and Elend descend toward the Well of Ascension. Preservation's appearance becomes less human—his face half-missing, his body decaying. He tells Kelsier the power must not be released but Vin will be deceived. Marsh, under Ruin's control, attacks Sazed at the entrance. Kelsier, desperate, grabs Preservation's arm and slashes Elend with it to motivate Vin to use the power.

title: Ruin Freed
description: Vin releases the power at the Well instead of using it, shattering Ruin's prison. The power rips through the barrier. Preservation guides Vin to feed Elend the last bead of lerasium, transforming him into a Mistborn and saving his life. Kelsier watches the world change as Ruin's full consciousness spills across Scadrial.

title: The Survivor's Grief
description: In the days after the koloss battle, Kelsier leaves the Well and travels through Luthadel's Cognitive reflection to Keep Venture, where he finds his surviving crew holding a funeral. He learns that Dockson and Clubs were killed—heroes both. Grabbing Preservation in fury at his apathy, Kelsier instead feels the depth of Preservation's love for humanity and embraces him. Preservation shows him distant people to the south and mentions someone who might help him do the impossible.

title: Khriss and Nazh
description: Following Preservation's tendril east out of the city, Kelsier reaches Lake Luthadel where the Cognitive Realm feels more solid. He finds a campfire with two strangers—Khriss and Nazh—who recognize him and are amazed he exists in this realm. Khriss lectures him on the sixteen Shards and Adonalsium. Nazh gifts Kelsier his knife and points him toward the Ire.

title: Vision of Godhood
description: Preservation gazes into Kelsier's eyes, giving him a vision of godhood and possible futures. In no future does Kelsier defeat Ruin, but he senses Vin has a chance—if he goes west. His Connection to Ruin runs far deeper than to Preservation, a fact that disturbs him. Preservation insists the Ire will not help, but Kelsier doesn't plan on asking.

title: Running West
description: Kelsier runs west along the Imperial Canal toward the ocean. As a Cognitive Shadow, he doesn't tire—as long as he doesn't think about exhaustion. He passes through towns empty from the encroaching mist sickness, the ash falling thicker than ever as Ruin accelerates the world's decay.

title: Memories of Longsfollow
description: Pausing at Longsfollow—a town where he once killed noblemen in retribution for a murdered skaa girl—Kelsier is hit with exhaustion and guilt. The Inquisitors came afterward, killing even more. He asks Preservation where Mare is. A madman in the building hears him but cannot comprehend. Realizing how long he has been running, he feels true exhaustion for the first time since leaving Luthadel before pressing on into the empty west.

title: The Lonely Road
description: West of Longsfollow, Kelsier stops at a fire pit and discovers he can start flames with his mind alone. The ash falls thicker than ever, and he watches skaa refugees fleeing ever westward to escape the encroaching destruction. Utterly alone, he craves any kind of interaction—even with Hoid—as he continues his relentless march toward the distant ocean.

title: Ruin's Taunt
description: After weeks of running, Kelsier reaches the western ocean. Ati (Ruin) appears and monologues about the inevitability of decay, telling him the end is very near. He taunts Kelsier that he can do no good out here—which leads Kelsier to conclude the opposite must be true. Ruin mocks him about the Eleventh Metal being his ruse, trying to break Kelsier's will. Kelsier presses on, setting out across the Cognitive Realm ocean.

title: The Ocean of Thought
description: Kelsier crosses the Cognitive Realm ocean with only a makeshift torch for light in the endless darkness. Far from Scadrial, he feels a tugging at his soul—an indication he is leaving his own world behind. He trudges through a strange jungle that gradually thins, its trees becoming jagged stone-like sculptures, until he sees a brilliant light ahead: the Ire's fortress.
placementNote: ⚠️ Placed far west of the known map — Kelsier is crossing the Cognitive Realm between worlds.

title: The Ire Fortress
description: Kelsier reaches a towering fortress of glowing white stone far beyond Scadrial. Climbing its walls by sinking his hands into the stone, he eavesdrops on the Ire—ancient Elantrians guarding a device that could capture Preservation's power. They plan to take the Shard themselves. Kelsier finds a description of the orb device and resolves to steal it, but decides force is too risky.

title: Stealing the Orb
description: Kelsier stalks the Ire as they ride out with the orb. He terrorizes them by pretending to be Ruin, slashing a horse's leg with Nazh's knife and creating a flaming cloak puppet. When Alonoe is separated from the group, he knocks out her guard and whispers from the shadows for her to leave the orb. She complies, terrified, and Kelsier begins the long run back east with his prize.

title: Fadrex and Hoid
description: After weeks of running back across the continent, Preservation tells Kelsier to go to Fadrex. A thin line of light leads him through the city to a square crowded with beggars—where he finds Vin, and once again meets Hoid, who shocks him but otherwise ignores him. Kelsier tries desperately to warn Vin about her earring spike and to avoid Hoid, but she seems to only half-hear him. Ruin attacks Kelsier with spiritual force, revealing the Eleventh Metal was his manipulation all along.

title: Ruin's Pawns Revealed
description: Every time Kelsier tries to reach Vin, Ruin blocks his path. From outside Fadrex, he watches koloss attack Elend's army at the ash mounds—and as they die, he sees their true forms: humans from all walks of life, created by Hemalurgy. Preservation shows him a vision of every person Ruin controls through spikes: Inquisitors stalking the land, Vin with her earring, King Penrod on the throne of Luthadel, Spook in Urteau, and his brother Marsh—who, even now, is in Luthadel driving a spike through Penrod's heart.

title: The Garbled Warning
description: Kelsier searches the army camp outside Fadrex for days, looking for a semi-insane soldier he can communicate with to warn Vin: don't trust anyone pierced with metal. The man garbles the message and merely starts a brawl. Ruin arrives to taunt him once more. Realizing he can do no more here—Ruin's attention is too focused on Vin and Elend—Kelsier turns his awareness elsewhere. Far to the north, in Urteau, a young Tineye named Spook burns with devotion to the Survivor. That Connection might be strong enough to use.

title: The Survivor's Shadow
description: Kelsier arrives in Urteau, seeking the young Tineye whose devotion to him burns like a beacon. He finds Spook under Ruin's influence—a Hemalurgic spike in his body, the god of destruction urging him to murder. But Ruin's attention here is thinner than at Fadrex. Kelsier bides his time, waiting for the right moment to act, watching Spook move through the city and sensing the lines of Connection between them growing stronger.

title: Hope for Spook
description: Kelsier finds Spook in Urteau, where Ruin is urging him to murder. The lines of Connection between them are stronger than with anyone else—Spook's devotion to the Survivor created a unique bond. Kelsier whispers 'hope' to Spook repeatedly, and eventually Spook removes his Hemalurgic spike. Kelsier then shouts 'survive' and Spook springs into action as Ruin begins burning the city.

title: The Half-Dream
description: Spook and Kelsier meet in a half-dream on green grass—the young Tineye's spirit wounded but his will intact. Kelsier tells Spook he is a hero and is proud of him. He urges Spook to get a message to Vin: anyone pierced by metal can be controlled by Ruin. Spook nods as he awakens, determined.

title: Taking Preservation
description: Feeling Preservation dying, Kelsier smashes the Ire's orb with Nazh's knife and takes up the Shard's power after a desperate struggle. But Ruin laughs—Kelsier is a memory of a person and cannot fully control it. Everything he tries to do is blocked. He hears Marsh fighting inside his own mind and realizes he must act indirectly, not confront Ruin head-on.

title: The Messenger's Fall
description: Kelsier watches as Goradel rides from Urteau bearing Spook's warning inscribed on metal—but Ruin summons Marsh. The Inquisitor descends on the messenger and kills him, reading the message aloud to his master. Kelsier thanks Goradel as the soldier's soul passes through the Cognitive Realm, then sinks into despair. But a thought cuts through: Ruin is not complete without the atium. There is still hope.
placementNote: ⚠️ Placed along the Imperial Canal between Urteau and Luthadel — exact ambush point is approximate.

title: Ceding the Power
description: Kelsier watches Vin fight the remaining Inquisitors at Kredik Shaw—then Marsh tortures her, driving spikes deeper. But Marsh has read the warning he took from Goradel's corpse. He reaches out and pulls the earring spike from Vin's ear. Kelsier seizes the moment, attacking Ruin to distract him as Vin draws in the mists and takes up Preservation's power. His soul rips apart as he cedes the Shard to her, but Ruin is too distracted to finish him off.

title: The Soul's Repair
description: Kelsier is in agony. The pull of death tugs at him once more—but he holds on, deciding again not to die, a choice available to him by virtue of having Ascended. His soul is deeply wounded from ceding Preservation to Vin, but in time it begins to repair. Ruin was too distracted to finish him off. From the Cognitive Realm, Kelsier watches the hundreds of thousands of refugees gathered at the Pits, the kandra moving the atium, and Vin—now Preservation—whispering on the wind to guide Elend.

title: Watcher at the Pits
description: Kelsier watches the final battle unfold. Elend gives his speech to the Seers and leads them charging into the koloss army. For hours Elend burns through a fortune of atium—then Kelsier sees him flare with impossible brilliance, burning duralumin and atium together in a final flash of godlike insight. Elend drives his sword into Marsh's neck as the axe takes him in the chest. He dies smiling. Then Vin attacks—Preservation striking Ruin in a fury neither Shard was meant to survive. Both Ati and Vin die. The powers of Preservation and Ruin are released upon the world.

title: The Beyond
description: Kelsier considers taking both Shards himself. Then Elend arrives in the Cognitive Realm—then Vin. They embrace, reunited at last. Ati comes next and Kelsier punches him. Together they watch as Sazed reaches out and takes both Preservation and Ruin, the powers that seem to belong together, and becomes Harmony. Sazed offers to send Vin back, but she knows that won't work. She wishes to move on with Elend. Vin thanks Kelsier for all he has done for her, and follows Elend into the Beyond.

title: The Survivor's Choice
description: The world is destroyed and reborn. During the Catacendre, Kelsier sees all three Realms at once. When it ends, he is again trapped in the Cognitive Realm. Sazed (Harmony) visits and admits he cannot bring Vin and Elend back from the Beyond. Kelsier asks him to heal Spook and make him a Mistborn. When Sazed says there is no way back to the Physical Realm, Kelsier decides Harmony is a terrible liar—and begins to scheme.
placementNote: ⚠️ Approximate placement — after the Catacendre, the world has been completely remade. Old landmarks no longer exist. This is the field of flowers and green grass where Vin and Elend are found.

title: The Survivor's Scheme
description: Kelsier convinces Spook to experiment with Hemalurgy—both to extend Spook's life and to find a way for Kelsier to return to the Physical Realm. The Survivor of Hathsin has no intention of remaining a Cognitive Shadow forever.
